steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to Beszel's APP_URL. Turn Let's Encrypt off for a name that is not public.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at the Beszel hub, upgrade the agent WebSocket and keep PocketBase's JSON errors.

steps.title: Methods and request rate
steps.subtitle: Allow PATCH and DELETE for the dashboard and load its many small requests without throttling.

steps.title: HTTP - Live updates
steps.subtitle: Keep the live-update stream open past 60 seconds so a dashboard tab does not reconnect every minute. Enter 60s, BunkerWeb's default, to go back to it.

steps.title: Security - Real client address
steps.subtitle: Replace client-sent forwarding headers so the hub records the real address of a browser or agent.

steps.title: HTTP - Backup upload
steps.subtitle: Accept a PocketBase backup ZIP between 10 and 16 MiB when you restore from the superuser UI. If you never upload a backup, enter 10m, BunkerWeb's default.

steps.title: Security - Review CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for the exact dashboard filter shapes, live subscriptions, logs filter, OAuth collection edit and LAN webhook URLs.
